reviews.title: Stingy Business Practices
reviews.text:
I really enjoy FitOn’s workouts and appreciate that the exercises are free. I’ve been a member since I discovered the app which has been a few years. However, I’m extremely disappointed that casting workouts to a television is no longer free and is locked behind buying FitOn Pro. 

Casting used to be available for free, and it made following workouts much easier. I don’t need meal plans, music, downloads, or the other premium features. I simply want to watch the workouts on a larger screen. I also want to mention that downloading the app on your TV and logging in used to be an option too and now isn’t for the LG Oled tv that I have. 

I would happily consider a lower-cost casting only option, but paying for an entire subscription just to use one feature that was previously free feels unreasonable and low of the company to do. 

It’s disappointing because I genuinely liked this app and wanted to continue using it regularly. It always seems like when a person is just trying to better themselves they get blocked by companies who just want your money. I will no longer be using this app or recommending it to friends and family.

reviews.title: fire tv not supported
reviews.text: Despite what the app description says streaming with the Fire TV doesn’t work. It only works on newer televisions. Don’t bother getting a pro subscription if you have an old smart television.

reviews.title: Free?
reviews.text: I thought that this App was advertised as free, but every aspect and workout requires me to join for the year.

reviews.title: Too much choice
reviews.text: Too confusing. Not for me.

reviews.title: Not for beginners
reviews.text: I’m so disappointed in this app. I’m 57 with fibromyalgia and I really thought this app would help me on my weight and strength training. There’s no way I can even keep up with these trainers. And yes I did the senior session for us older folks. But hey I wish everyone a great journey and keep strong.

reviews.title: Shady subscription
reviews.text: The subscription is through their website so it’s not linked to your Apple account. They don’t warn you that the subscription is renewing. They bill it and send you the receipt and when you try to cancel it tells you a 24-hour notice is required. Every other subscription I have provides advance notice of billing.

reviews.title: This is NOT FREE
reviews.text: I read great reviews about this app and wanted to try it out. The description says it’s “absolutely free” to use but I can’t look at any exercise routines unless I pay. How am I to try it out before I commit?

reviews.title: Not for beginners.
reviews.text:
It’s great that it has a free option, but honestly the coaches don’t give you time to learn the exercises - you are just immediately immersed into an intense timed lesson which is hard to keep up with. 
When you fail you give up. How is that good training? Bad reviews don’t seem to appear - maybe they have been blocked. For instance- I can’t find this one.

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: Cannot even create an account. It keeps telling me to fix my email. I used 4 different ones. Weird.

reviews.title: Location
reviews.text: I previously used this app and the locations for the workouts were very appropriate like yoga overlooking an ocean scene. Now it looks like they are working in someone’s basement on a cement floor with the walls painted white. It looks cheap and is distracting compared to other fitness apps that the workouts are in a gym setting. Also the training is not as good as it used to be.  The trainers jump right into the workout with no warm up or cool down. That can cause injuries. I have the pro version and tried to cancel it but am stuck for a year. Waste of money! Do not recommend.

reviews.title: Screen mirroring
reviews.text: Love this app but hate that it literally blocks you from screen mirroring to your tv :( I can’t afford internet right now let alone a premium subscription so it just sucks that I have to do it off of my tiny phone screen

reviews.title: Lost Chromecast Functionality
reviews.text:
Loved this app but it no longer works with Chromecast on iPhone (they switched casting function from AirPlay to Screen Mirroring). Watching on a tiny iPhone is NOT worth paying for….

Contacted support who insisted it was my devices or network, despite Chromecast working perfectly fine with literally every other app I own besides this one (make that make sense?). 

Disappointed I discovered this all right after my subscription renewed. I will NOT be renewing again, and the lack of support makes me hesitate to recommend to anyone else. Plenty of other workout apps that will cast fine to my devices (including YouTube).

reviews.title: Kinda disgusting
reviews.text: I have back, wrist, and knee injuries. While attempting to maybe set preferences for workouts that don't rely on those parts of the body, it asked for my insurance information??? You do not need my insurance information to provide workouts that work for people with injuries.

reviews.title: Multiple Accounts
reviews.text: I’d like to be able to have multiple accounts on the tv app. Am I also allowed to ask for categories based on  morning, afternoon, or evening workouts as separate categories.

reviews.title: App not working
reviews.text: The app will not load up. Not sure what’s going on. This is one of the best apps ever. I recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: Use to be Good
reviews.text: Now it’s trash, pay for everything. I was using the app way before they started charging. Now charge to your own music, charge to mirror. I have never paid to use this features until I came to use it. I will no longer tell people to download this app or use this app.

reviews.title: BEWARE!!!
reviews.text: So my mom recommended this app to me. Saying it was free . Not only does it throw upgrade flyers I. Your face at every turn and ads .but the scarier part  I thought was interesting is that they had a rehab exercise section for lower back pain.   I thought since I had been in a car accident in January. This might be a good option. Well it wouldn’t let me start the program unless I entered insurance. So I added my old insurance policy. And then it let me access it. At no point did it verify that the insurance would have coverage for any of this. And there’s a disclaimer at the bottom that you will accept any and all fees if you’re insurance doesn’t pay for this. I’ve worked in dental insurance before and the moment you have insurance, they’ll generally bill you three times the amount of a self-pay cost. This disclaimer allows them to bill you whatever they deem necessary. But making you feel covered because you have insurance. THERES NO prices LISTED ANYWHERE FOR WHAT THESE rehab exercises cost and you don’t even get to see what it entails. This essentially places no cost ceiling . without giving any sort of price transparency they can BILL YOU WHATEVER THEY WANT.  I would also recommend you read all their terms in agreement and consent forms because it does allow them to auto bill you for those things!! It’s super SKETCHY AND DISHONEST PRACTICE.

reviews.title: As bad as the rest of them
reviews.text: I loathe those draconian apps that force you to update, as a customer, you should have the option to choose. Needless to say they track you across all other apps and sites. It’s about time we get to choose who sits on our table of home screen. Won’t be missed. Farewell!

reviews.title: Forced to pay
reviews.text: Forced to pay and forced to leave a review on each exercise!

reviews.title: Bring back casting to TV
reviews.text: This app is useless on a tiny phone screen. Please bring back casting for ALL levels of accounts. I used to use this daily but now I’m ready to delete my account and the app. 😡

reviews.title: Good app but impossible to stop incessant notifications
reviews.text: Some great work outs, but Fiton need to address their constant stream of notifications and emails, i have set all notifications to off and still receive at least one per day, unsubscribed from mails multiple times and still getting them

reviews.title: Please fix the favorites!
reviews.text: You broke the favorites again the last update!!!!!!!  Now, every time I select 1 and go back, I’m at the top of my list and have to try and fine where I left off. Put it back so it stays where I was on the list.  This is not the 1st time you’ve messed this up!!! I’m ready to stop paying for the subscription and find an app that doesn’t break itself with updates !!!

reviews.title: App will not let me sign up
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and got an error message saying my email was invalid. I would like to try the app but have been unable to create and account because the app does not recognize a Gmail account.

reviews.title: Anti Pattern Marketing
reviews.text: So far I have enjoyed the workouts, and even went ‘pro’ thinking it would be a good value. I get really frustrated that the ‘add ons’ are so prominently promoted- but not clearly marked as items that cost extra. There are programs included in pro and programs that have to be paid for. Workouts are free/included but courses are paid. Most of the time you don’t know if you have to pay until your three taps in. Overall I like the app and wish there was a way to pay for a level where I’m not  constantly getting ads and asked to pay for more. I’ll keep looking for a better experience that doesn’t have shady marketing practices.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I did not sign up for Pro. Today I get a charge from my bank for 39.99$
How did you even get my credit card number??? I never gave it. This is STEALING

reviews.title: Not working after the recent update
reviews.text: It keeps saying no active internet when trying to do on demand workout. Wi-Fi is connected and other functions are working fine.

reviews.title: Loved this app for years but not working anymore
reviews.text: I’ve had FitOn for 4+ years and loved it. Unfortunately, as of today, the app refuses to work. The app keeps insisting I do not have internet access (incorrect: I am connected to the internet), while my daughter, who has a previous version of the app, has no issues. I’ve tried to contact FitOn, but the bot on their Contact Us does not understand the simplest message (“app not working”). No phone number for support (unless you’re a Medicare patient or a corporate entity). Sorry, FitOn, the love affair may be over.
